mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id, i.name, i.description, i.price::numeric AS price, i.added_at, i.updated_at, i.quantity, i.category_id, i.wear_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, it.tag_id, im.guid FROM item i INNER JOIN user_ u ON i.seller_cip = u.cip LEFT JOIN tag_item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id LEFT JOIN item_image im ON im.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.seller_cip = #{cip} AND (im.displayorder = 1 OR im.guid IS NULL) AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.quantity > 0;

SELECT i.item_id, i.name, i.description, i.price::numeric AS price, i.added_at, i.updated_at, i.quantity, c.name as category_name, w.name as wear_name, i.seller_cip, p.name as payment_option, d.name as delivery_option, it.tag_id FROM item i INNER JOIN category c ON i.category_id = c.category_id INNER JOIN wear w ON i.wear_id = w.wear_id LEFT JOIN tag_item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id LEFT JOIN item_paym_option ip ON ip.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN payment_option p ON ip.payment_optn_id = p.payment_optn_id LEFT JOIN item_del_option id ON id.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN delivery_option d ON id.delivery_optn_id = d.delivery_optn_id WHERE i.item_id = #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.quantity > 0;
SELECT i.item_id, i.name, i.description, i.seller_cip, i.price::numeric, i.quantity FROM item i WHERE i.item_id = #{id};
SELECT COUNT(i.item_id) FROM user_ u INNER JOIN item i ON i.seller_cip = u.cip WHERE i.seller_cip = #{cip} AND i.quantity = 0;
mapper.insert: insert into item (name, description, price, added_at, updated_at, sold, quantity, category_id, wear_id, seller_cip) values (#{item.name}, #{item.description}, #{item.price}, now(), now(), false, #{item.quantity}, #{item.categoryId}, #{item.wearId}, #{item.sellerCip})
INSERT INTO favorite (cip, item_id, added_at) VALUES (#{cip}, #{id}, NOW());
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite f WHERE f.cip = #{cip} AND f.item_id = #{id};
mapper.update:
UPDATE item
name = #{item.name},
description = #{item.description},
price = #{item.price},
quantity = #{item.quantity},
category_id = #{item.categoryId},
wear_id = #{item.wearId},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE item_id = #{item.itemId} AND seller_cip = #{sellerCip}
UPDATE item set deleted_at = now() where item_id = #{id}
UPDATE order_ SET archived_at = now() WHERE item_id = #{id};
